meanings.FORWARD: Beckon toward yourself using one, several, or all fingers.
meanings.BACKWARD: Push your hand outward to signal go away.
meanings.LEFT: Point toward the left side of the mirrored preview.
meanings.RIGHT: Point toward the right side of the mirrored preview.
meanings.STOP: Hold a closed fist still, distinct from beckoning.
meanings.NO_COMMAND: No intended command: resting, unrelated motion, transitions, or no hand.
meanings.UP: Deliberately point upward or move the hand upward to request UP; varied styles allowed.
meanings.DOWN: Deliberately point downward or move the hand downward to request DOWN; varied styles allowed.
